description: This Dart source file defines a custom Flutter theme named Ocean Theme, which includes theme data for colors, text styles, app bar styles, card styles, input decorations, and navigation rail styles. It also provides a function to generate a background gradient decoration.

methods.name: buildOceanTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a customized ThemeData object with colors, text styles, and component themes tailored for an ocean-inspired aesthetic.

methods.name: _roundedBorder
methods.description: Creates a rounded OutlineInputBorder with the specified border color.

methods.name: oceanGradientBackground
methods.description: Returns a BoxDecoration with a linear gradient background, using theme colors.
